thread:
kevin: Postmortem follow-up: last night's partial-stream / timeout surge looks tied to aggressive client reconnect loops + lack of short-term server attach window. Proposed remediation: short session_grace on server, explicit chunk_commit, SDK soft-attach with jittered backoff, and a circuit-breaker metric. Owners below.

liya: Can you drop the minimal staging config you tested? I can run the canary.

kevin: Staging patch we tried:
```yaml
streaming:
  session_grace_ms: 1800
  emit_chunk_commit: true
  ack_window_ms: 120
  per_session_limit: 8
```

marc: Good call on per_session_limit. That prevents single client floods. I'll run a 5% canary for 45m, watch duplicate-init and partial_chunk_rate.

infra-bot: scheduled deploy: infra-canary/session-grace-1717894321 by marc at 20:00 UTC

samir: SDK changes: adding soft-attach API (attempt attach before new init), jittered exponential backoff, and doc note recommending reconnect window >= 1200ms. PRs created: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1342 (js) and /pull/1343 (ios).

liya: Canary metrics after 30m: partial_chunk_rate -60%, duplicate-init -70%. No CPU spike. Proceeding to 25% canary.

kevin: Added an interim 429 behavior: servers return Retry-After with randomized 800-1400ms when per-session limit hit. This prevents tight client loops while SDKs roll out.

alerts-bot: canary alert: partial_chunk_rate improved, no new budget burn.

marc: 25% canary stable. Scheduling prod rollout in 1h with post-deploy check at +30m.

kevin: Action items (owner | ETA | status):
- prod rollout session_grace + chunk_commit | marc | +1h | rolling
- SDK soft-attach & backoff | samir | +2d | PRs open
- 429 Retry-After + docs | samir | +3d | done (temp header added)
- add metric session_reattach_rate & circuit-breaker | kevin | +3d | todo
- regression eval & weekly recurrence digest | liya | +4d | in progress (ticket R-STREAM-77)
- customer follow-ups for affected tenants | support | +2d | todo

infra-bot: incident-log: linked recurrence R-STREAM-77, postmortem URL: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/pm-2026-03-streaming-reconnect

samir: Putting a short blurb in SDK changelog referencing this incident and the recommended reconnect window.

liya: Post-deploy quick check: all good at +30m, partials down ~75% globally. Scheduling a follow-up review next Tuesday to validate recurrence metrics.

kevin: Thanks all. Thread will be canonical action log for this remediation. Reopen if we see reappearance or side-effects.
